text:
marta: Quick heads-up: Python SDK 0.9.2 returns 404 for the private-models pin endpoint used by our sampleapp onboarding. curl to the REST API works fine.

kai: ouch. can you paste the exact request/response?

marta: logs show:
```
POST /v1/private/models/pin
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx
Body: {\"model_id\": \"redwood-123\"}

HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
{\"error\": \"Not found\"}
```
but `curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/enterprise/private/models/pin` returns 200 with model metadata.

ben: which SDK and version?

marta: python sdk 0.9.2 from pip. sampleapp calls `client.private.models.pin(model_id)`

sam-sdk: thanks — triaging. We recently rehomed private endpoints under `/v1/enterprise/...` for enterprise/private deployments. SDK should map `client.private.*` -> enterprise path when tenant_type=enterprise. looks like 0.9.2 doesn't.

marta: I enabled REDWOOD_SDK_DEBUG and captured the full URL: `https://api.redwood.ai/v1/private/models/pin` so it's not rewriting.

ci-bot: @sam-sdk created issue RDW-4578 (sdk: private endpoint routing) and a draft PR template. :robot_face:

sam-sdk: i'll open a patch. plan: if client.config.tenant_type == 'enterprise' use `/v1/enterprise/private/...`. keep default unchanged for hosted users. add unit tests.

olivia: will docs need a quickstarter note? onboarding guide currently shows the `private` example only.

ben: also consider a soft fallback: if old route returns 404 and header `X-Enterprise-Suggest: true` is present, retry once to enterprise route and log a warning. preserves backwards compatibility for some installs.

sam-sdk: prefer explicit config + optional fallback. i'll implement both: explicit mapping when config present, and fallback on 404 + suggest header. tests to cover both.

marta: patched local wheel + re-ran sampleapp onboarding — pin step now succeeds. :tada:

sam-sdk: opened PR with tests and changelog entry. reviewer pinged.

ci-bot: PR merged to main (sam-sdk). CI pipeline started.

marta: verified staging build 1852012369 — onboarding flow green.

sam-sdk: published 0.9.3 to PyPI with changelog: "fix: private models route mapping for enterprise tenants (python)"

olivia: docs quickstart and migration FAQ updated to mention tenant_type for Private installs.

ben: recommend canary for 24h on staging then promote.

marta: confirmed sampleapp works with 0.9.3. closing after canary.

ben: nice cross-team response, thanks everyone.
